generated_images.prompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic wide shot of a sleek, futuristic cyberpunk hovering vehicle suspended above a rain-slicked obsidian asphalt street, intricate micro-textures on carbon-fiber chassis with glowing neon circuitry, heavy atmospheric downpour with individual crystalline raindrops captured in mid-air, soft iridescent rim lighting reflecting off wet surfaces, volumetric god rays piercing through dense blue and magenta neon haze, deep shadows and radiant highlights, shot on Hasselblad 100MP, 85mm f/1.4 lens, razor-sharp focus on the vehicle’s metallic engine components, bokeh-blurred urban cityscape in the background, Octane render 3D detail, 8K resolution, photorealistic masterpiece, dramatic moody lighting, hyper-detailed mechanical precision.
cyberpunk girl standing under neon rain in neo-Tokyo, modern anime aesthetic, Makoto Shinkai style, vibrant colors, clean lines

A breathtaking, ultra-realistic photograph of an elegant, pristine white cat serenely perched on a weathered, rustic wooden garden bench. The cat features plush, extraordinarily soft fur rendered with visible individual hairs, delicate translucent whiskers, and mesmerizing, jewel-toned eyes with intricate iris patterns that catch the ambient light. The antique bench displays rich, tactile wood grain with subtle peeling textures and dark cast-iron scrollwork, lightly dusted with a few scattered dry leaves. The setting is a tranquil, secluded park pathway during late golden hour, where warm volumetric god rays filter through the dense canopy of ancient oak trees, creating a soft atmospheric mist and dappled shadows. Radiant, golden rim lighting delicately outlines the cat’s graceful silhouette, while gentle ambient fill light illuminates the quiet contentment of its expression. Captured with an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, the composition boasts tack-sharp focus on the feline's face against a creamy, cinematic bokeh background, achieving an exquisite balance of photorealistic fidelity, rich dynamic range, and serene stillness.

A dynamic low-angle tracking photograph capturing a classic 1970s sports car drifting aggressively around a narrow switchback on a rain-dampened mountain cliffside road. The vehicle, finished in a brilliant high-gloss burnt-orange lacquer with subtle road grit, showcases sculpted curvaceous body lines, gleaming polished chrome trim, and spinning vintage alloy wheels that scatter vibrant red and gold fallen leaves in their wake. On one side, rugged, moss-covered granite cliffs loom overhead, while the other drops into a breathtaking alpine valley filled with a dense canopy of fiery autumn foliage—deep crimsons, bright ambers, and golden birches. Piercing late-afternoon golden hour sunlight breaks through the high-altitude haze, casting dramatic volumetric god rays across the tarmac and creating a brilliant golden rim light along the car's sleek contours. Crisp cool air and gentle exhaust heat distortion blend with the soft valley mist, while a fast shutter speed captures razor-sharp focus on the vehicle's bodywork against the smooth cinematic motion blur of the road and guardrail, rendered with the authentic depth of field, rich texture, and tactile quality of a 35mm medium-format editorial car photograph.
